svg.text: The (version, digest, commit-sha) triple is the rollback audit trail. 'Deploy v2.4.0' becomes a digest lookup that is

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: deterministic forever — not a tag lookup that depends on what was re-pushed last.
